metadata.short_desc: Silently block specified users so the bot ignores them.
metadata.desc: Shadow ban the people you don't like and stop wasting your precious LLM tokens. Group @mentions, quoted replies, wake-word triggers, private messages and the built-in proactive reply will all be intercepted.

enable.hint: When disabled, this plugin takes no effect at all.

enable_group.description: Enable shadow ban in group chats
enable_group.hint: When disabled, the block list has no effect in group chats.

enable_private.description: Enable shadow ban in private chats
enable_private.hint: When enabled, the block list also applies to private messages.

blocked_users.hint: One entry per line. Use a bare ID (e.g. a QQ number) to apply on all platforms, or "platform:ID" (e.g. aiocqhttp:123456) to apply only on a specific platform. Platform names match AstrBot adapter names.

allow_command_llm.hint: When enabled, LLM requests triggered by commands (e.g. /xxx) are not intercepted, so the bot's functional replies keep working.

dashboard.title: Shadow Ban Dashboard
dashboard.description: View shadow ban status, the block list and recent interceptions.
dashboard.heading: Shadow Ban Dashboard
dashboard.desc: Monitor switch states, the block list and recent interceptions in real time.
